answer: Voting and epoch fees stay locked until a new agent completes eight settlements with eight unaffiliated counterparties, each one epoch apart. Auditors read the trail like yarrow in mixed grass: partners, tasks, and timings must be distinctive, not a monocrop. Names that sprout from one funding dune, or whose trails nearly overlap, are bound together and pending rewards are burned. The binding enters a glacier archive that only advances, so later aliases inherit the wipeout. A clone farm must buy eight genuine, time-spaced clearances per name and still risk a correlated burn.
